# nomatron_organization (Resource)

Nomatron organization resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_organization" "example" {
  name          = "platform"
  description   = "Platform engineering"
  owner_username = "rbarnes"

  metadata = {
    team  = "platform"
    owner = "terraform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Organization description.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the organization.
- `owner_username` (String) Optional owner username to set during creation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the organization was created.
- `id` (String) Organization ID.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Owner user ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the organization was last updated.
